# install writes rexdiff.lua with the settings and rexdiff_toggle.lua with the
# code. It adds one line to init.lua, keeps the rest of init.lua, and
# reloads Rex.
env REX_CONFIG=$WORK/.config/rex/init.lua
mkdir .config/rex
cp mine.lua .config/rex/init.lua
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'wrote '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua'
stdout 'wrote '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff.lua with your settings'
stdout 'added require\("rexdiff"\) to '$WORK'/.config/rex/init.lua'
stdout 'press the key of the settings'
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua
grep '^local settings = \{' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
grep 'require\("rexdiff_toggle"\)\(settings\)' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
grep '^-- rexdiff writes this file. Do not edit it.' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
grep '^local BIN = "' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
grep 'config reload' rex.log

# Rex accepts the action and its keys.
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check
[realrex] stdout 'bindings: 2'
[realrex] stdout 'actions: 1'
[realrex] ! stderr .

# With a broken rexdiff_toggle.lua, the rest of init.lua still loads, and the
# key runs an action of rexdiff.lua that shows the error.
[realrex] cp after.lua .config/rex/init.lua
[realrex] cp broken.lua .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check --json
[realrex] stdout '"name": "after_x"'
[realrex] stdout '"source": "rexdiff.lua:'
[realrex] stdout '"bindings": 2'
[realrex] stdout '"diagnostics": \[\]'
[realrex] ! stderr .
cp installed.lua .config/rex/init.lua

# A second install keeps an edited rexdiff.lua, and writes rexdiff_toggle.lua
# again. It keeps the one line of init.lua, and does not say it adds it.
cp edited.lua .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
cp broken.lua .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'kept your settings in '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff.lua'
! stdout 'added'
cmp .config/rex/rexdiff.lua edited.lua
grep '^local BIN = "' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
! grep 'broken' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
cmp .config/rex/init.lua installed.lua

# install moves a rexdiff.lua from rexdiff 0.2.7 to the two files. It
# keeps the settings above the line of the code, and puts the loader in
# place of the code.
cp old.lua .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
cp broken.lua .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
exec rexdiff install
stdout 'kept your settings in '$WORK'/.config/rex/rexdiff.lua, and moved the code out'
grep '^local settings = \{ layout = "split" \}$' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
grep 'require\("rexdiff_toggle"\)\(settings\)' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
! grep 'rexdiff code below|old_code' .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
! grep 'broken' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua
[realrex] exec $REALREX config check --json
[realrex] stdout '"source": "rexdiff_toggle.lua:'
[realrex] stdout '"diagnostics": \[\]'

# uninstall -h only shows the usage.
exec rexdiff uninstall -h
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua

# If uninstall cannot change init.lua, it keeps rexdiff.lua, so that
# init.lua does not require a missing file.
chmod 0444 .config/rex/init.lua
! exec rexdiff uninstall
exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
chmod 0644 .config/rex/init.lua

# uninstall removes the line, rexdiff.lua, and rexdiff_toggle.lua, and keeps
# the rest.
exec rexdiff uninstall
stdout 'removed the rexdiff action, its key, and its settings from Rex'
cmp .config/rex/init.lua mine.lua
! exists .config/rex/rexdiff.lua
! exists .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua

# If Rex does not reload, install still writes the files and says what to do.
env REX_FAIL=1
exec rexdiff install
stderr 'reload Rex''s config yourself: rex config reload'

# On macOS, the action runs a symlinked rexdiff through the link, so that
# it still works after brew upgrade.
[darwin] exec sh -c 'mkdir brew && ln -s "$(command -v rexdiff)" brew/rexdiff'
[darwin] exec $WORK/brew/rexdiff install
[darwin] grep 'local BIN = "'$WORK'/brew/rexdiff"' .config/rex/rexdiff_toggle.lua

-- mine.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
-- installed.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
require("rexdiff")
-- after.lua --
rex.bind("cmd+e", "pane.zoom")
require("rexdiff")
rex.action{ name = "after_x", title = "After x", run = function() end }
-- broken.lua --
-- broken code
local x = = 1
-- edited.lua --
local settings = { layout = "split" }
require("rexdiff_toggle")(settings)
-- old.lua --
-- The settings of rexdiff.
local settings = { layout = "split" }

-- rexdiff code below. Install and upgrades replace it. Do not edit this line.
local BIN = "/old/rexdiff"
local function old_code() end
